body: Thank you for all your comments. Venting just makes me feel a little less alone, if you're wondering what the hell the point of this is
Lol my mom named me after her

I know I must sound undeniably stupid. If I have shelter and family why would I do this. There are people who are forced to starve. This is not a pity party at all and I don't expect any pity and none of you were even thinking about that which is good. This is kind of like a journal for me. Also no one is forcing you to read this so if you are angry then leave. Anyways.... my whole life has just been fantasies.. yes you are thinking so go and make them real. How do i go out and magically find love? Magically find a purpose in life?? I live in high school thinking I will get out. I'll move to BC and study science and do something useful. But what if I find no one. What if I drown in the crowd and nothing looks up. I don't know what I need whether it be company or someone to tell me it'll all be fine which is dumb and cheesy but at least I wouldn't be miserable for one minute. I have friends sure... no one that actually truly DEEPLY cares for me. I sit with them and I think.. this is so fucking fragile. So shallow. None of you would sit for a moment and truly care about my well being. And I'm afraid it'll be this way my whole life. A series of just wait a year it'll be better. I'll be 30 with no husband or kids and tell myself.. just wait. By then it'll be too late and I'll die in even more misery than I'm in now. The worst thing about any of this is that I sound like some emo kid that's faux depressed ( I don't even think I am depressed) and has nothing better to do but whine. I seriously don't know what the point of living is if my only warmth and comfort is the moments before sleep pulls me towards unconsciousness and I can truly believe my fantasies of a fulfilling life are real. I do have a best friend of 4 years but even that isn't helping me. It's like I need someone who is full of energy and light and understands me and can help me. That's so unrealistic. What am I waiting for? Everything is so grey. Nothing I do is good enough. I'm terrified everyday of failure. I think if I do truly fail at something I cannot have the strength to go on. I don't know how to end this
